title: ProteinAlphabet
description: IUPAC amino acid codes: the standard 20 (A,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,K,L,M,N,P,Q,R,S,T,V,W,Y) plus the ambiguity/special codes B (Asx), Z (Glx), X (any), J (Leu/Ile), U (selenocysteine), O (pyrrolysine) -- together these cover all 26 letters, so this pattern is effectively any letter. Also allows '*' for a stop codon, and '-'/'.' as alignment gap/missing-data characters, since a Sequence doubles as an alignment row. Case-insensitive.
